tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Lists Bulgarian cities covered by Domly with the number of active rental listings and the median monthly rent in EUR. Call this first to get city slugs for the other tools.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Searches active long-term rental listings in a Bulgarian city (collected daily from imot.bg, alo.bg and homes.bg, duplicates merged). Returns up to 10 listings with price, rooms, area, district and a link to view photos and details on Domly. Always show the user the "url" of each listing.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Details of one rental listing by its id from search_listings: parameters, amenities, a short description excerpt, the same flat on other sites, and links to Domly (photos, contact form) and to the original listing.

tools.name: get_price_stats
tools.description: Rental market statistics for a Bulgarian city from Domly's daily index: median monthly rent (EUR), 25th/75th percentiles, price per m², 30-day change, prices by apartment size and by district. Use it to answer "how much does it cost to rent in ..." questions; cite Domly as the source with the given

tools.name: request_realtor
tools.description: Sends the user's request to a local partner realtor in the city (or to the Domly team where there is no partner), who will contact the user and pick rental options for free. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_listings, get_price_stats · Private data: get_listing, request_realtor · Public sink: request_realtor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_listings, get_price_stats · Private data: get_listing, request_realtor · Public sink: request_realtor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
